lines: by Effie’s granddaughter, Colette Carney Wheatley, Dover,
of the children of Effie & James Carney
-- Allen Reed's wife's surname spelling variations: Dorothy Rebecca Gimson-Jemson-Jenson-Jameson-Simpson
Allen Reed was married to Rebecca Jenson, his wife March 6,
the following births were written as one long paragraph.)
Reed first daughter of Allen and his wife Rebecca was Bornde August 20,
Rosey Reed second daughter of Allen and his wife Rebecca was bornde May
Reed third daughter of Allen and Rebecca his wife was bornd April 7,
H. Reed first son of Allen and Rebecca his wife was bornd July 27,
(writing poor, probably Effilinda) Reed fourth daughter of Allen and Rebecca
Allen Reed second son of Allen and Rebecca his wife was bornd January
>i ? earther (writing poor) Garfield Reed third son of Allen and Rebecca
A. Reed fourth son of Allen and Rebecca his wife was bornd May 18 :
A. Reed fifth son of Allen and Rebecca his wife was bornd March 18,
R. Carney son of Robert and Elmira Carney bornd August 8,
E. Reed died on the 27th of April
(could be Lewis) A. Reed died on November 10
Reed a wife of Allen Reed.  (Bible says) she died February 13
but it is Allen who died on this date as proved by DE death cert. #
James Lesey Reed sixth son of Allen and Rebecca his wife was bornd March
Harry E. Reed seventh son of Allen and Rebecca his wife was bornd April
Leuis (may be Lewis) A. Reed Eight sond of Allen and Rebecca his wife
Hellen Reed fifth daughter of Allen and Rebecca his wife was bornd May
John C Allen Reed (can't tell if it is meant to be letter C or a careless
pen mark) was married to Rebecca Jemson  his wife March 6
(Died?  See above, Harry E. Reed born April
Annia Reed the first of Allen and Rebecca his wife was bornd August the
Rosey Reed the second daughter of Allen and Rebecca his wife was bornd
Rebecca his wife was bornd May 21,
Harrit Reed third daughter of Allen and Rebecca his wife was bornd April
William Henry Reed the first son of Allen and Rebecca his wife was bornd
Efelendiea (Effelinda?) Reed fourth daughter of Allen and Rebecca his
wife was bornd November (no day or year)
and his wife was bornd November 19,
John Allen Reed was second son of Allen and his wife was bornd January
James earther garfield Reed the third son of Allen and his
Harvey A. Reed the fourth son of Allen and Rebecca his wife was bornd
Walter A Reed the fifth son of Allen and Rebecca his wife was bornd March
James lesey ??  Reed the sixth son of Allen and Rebecca his wife
